Package Fitness.AdminPackage

Class User

java.lang.Object
Fitness.AdminPackage.User
Direct Known Subclasses:
Admin, Client, Instructor
public class User extends Object
Represents a user in the fitness system, which can have various roles and properties. The User class contains personal information, a list of messages, notifications, and posts, and handles various user-related activities such as managing points, messages, and notifications. It also supports user authentication and role management.

The class provides methods to manage personal information, including name, age, address, and password, as well as user-specific data such as program participation, dietary preferences, and restrictions.

Author:
Ibrahim Mashaqi
